sections.Profile:
The "Judge Dredd" pinball machine by Bally, released in 1993, is based on the British comic strip from "2000 AD". Designed by John Trudeau, it features unique elements such as the rotating Deadworld model that captures balls, and the "SuperGame" mechanic, which includes four unique modes and a six-ball multiball.
